        /usr/bin/bwrap: no such file or directory

· did not start · permission

 ▎✗ ran ./deploy.sh       did not start · permission

     ▎✗ ./deploy.sh       did not start · permission
        permission denied: fork/exec ./deploy.sh:
        permission denied
        Nothing ran. The refusal is the operating
        system's and not a decision this session
        made or can undo, so use a program and a
        path the current user is already allowed, or
        report what is refusing it.
